generatedFrom.source: registry.json via scripts/gen-discovery.mjs (metadata only — never component source)

items.name: money
items.title: Money format
items.description: The single formatting boundary for billing-kit Money. Every amount rendered by any component goes through formatMoney here, so amount-as-number math never enters the tree.

items.name: format-config
items.title: Format config
items.description: A React context carrying the locale and Money/Quantity formatters so a subtree formats consistently; invoice-view reads it.

items.name: plans
items.title: Plans vocabulary
items.description: The shared plan/tier vocabulary for the pricing group: the Plan shape (price is a billing-kit Money, never a number) and the declared tier rank that plan-change-control reads instead of comparing amounts.

items.name: use-usage
items.title: useUsage
items.description: Headless hook over billing-kit queryUsage. Returns StoredUsageEvent rows and UsageAggregate quantities as Quantity, never as number.

items.name: use-balance
items.title: useBalance
items.description: Headless hook over billing-kit balance. Returns Money and defers all formatting to money-format.

items.name: use-entitlement
items.title: useEntitlement
items.description: Headless hook the installing app uses to read its own end-users' entitlements. This is a product feature, not the seat gate: the seat gate lives at install time in front of the registry, never in shipped source.

items.name: usage-meter
items.title: Usage meter
items.description: A quota meter for a metered subject. Reads UsageAggregate quantities and a plan limit; renders the ratio without ever coercing a Quantity or an amount to number.

items.name: usage-chart
items.title: Usage chart
items.description: A time-bucketed usage chart over UsageWindow aggregates. Axis ticks are Quantity-derived labels, formatted by their own scale, not divided.

items.name: quota-bar
items.title: Quota bar
items.description: A quota bar with ok/warning/over states. Used and limit are Quantity; the remainder and overage are exact bigint differences rendered as strings, never floats.

items.name: rate-display
items.title: Rate display
items.description: A unit-rate readout. The amount is priced by billing-kit price() over a Rate and a block size, then formatted through money-format — never a dollars-per-unit reinterpretation of minor units.

items.name: pricing-table
items.title: Pricing table
items.description: A plan comparison table. Each cell is a Money rendered through money-format; a rate column shows minor-units-per-unit as billing-kit stores it, never a dollars-per-unit reinterpretation.

items.name: plan-card
items.title: Plan card
items.description: A single plan tier card. Price is Money formatted by money-format; the period and currency tag come from the plan, never inferred by scaling.

items.name: plan-picker
items.title: Plan picker
items.description: A radiogroup over plans. Each option shows its Money price through money-format; selection is a PlanTier, never an amount.

items.name: tier-comparison
items.title: Tier comparison
items.description: A feature-by-tier comparison table with a Money price row rendered through money-format.

items.name: promo-code
items.title: Promo code
items.description: A promo-code entry field. The applied discount is a Money or basis-points value from the app; the component displays it via money-format and never computes a discounted price itself.

items.name: plan-change-control
items.title: Plan change control
items.description: Upgrade/downgrade confirmation between two plans. Direction comes from the declared tier rank in plans, not from comparing prices; the delta is Money.minus within one currency.

items.name: ledger-table
items.title: Ledger table
items.description: The append-only double-entry ledger as a table. Debits and credits are LedgerLeg Money values, formatted by money-format; the running balance is billing-kit's balance, never a client-side sum.

items.name: invoice-view
items.title: Invoice view
items.description: A settled-period invoice from SettlementResult lines. Line totals and the invoice total are Money through money-format; the residue from price() is shown, not hidden, so the invoice and the ledger reconcile.

items.name: balance-badge
items.title: Balance badge
items.description: A compact current-balance badge for a subject. Money in, money-format out; the sign convention follows billing-kit's ledger, positive debit and negative credit.

items.name: checkout-panel
items.title: Checkout panel
items.description: A plan-selection and confirm block that hands a subscription intent to a BillingProvider. It renders amounts through money-format and never captures payment itself; capture is the provider's, per billing-kit's boundary.

items.name: stripe-payment-fields
items.title: Stripe payment fields
items.description: Stripe Elements hosted fields; raw card data never touches the component or your server. Confirms a SetupIntent/PaymentIntent the app created via a BillingProvider.

items.name: paddle-checkout
items.title: Paddle checkout
items.description: Paddle.js hosted checkout overlay/inline; the component opens the checkout for a price the app resolved and reports completion, never capturing payment itself.

items.name: price-editor
items.title: Price editor
items.description: Superadmin price editor. Prices are versioned and never mutated in place; a draft is a Money via Money.fromDecimalString and a Rate via Rate.fromDecimalString, both exact.

items.name: promo-manager
items.title: Promo manager
items.description: Superadmin promo-code manager. Codes carry redemption caps and expiry as first-class fields; amount discounts are Money through money-format.

items.name: entitlement-toggles
items.title: Entitlement toggles
items.description: Superadmin per-tenant entitlement switches. Emits toggle intents; the app owns the entitlement store (this is not the seat gate).
